permissionRules: Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.
Full ShareDialog owner form is owned by this workspace inventory. Settings inventory owns ShareManagement listing/entry only; public inventory owns anonymous reader/editor.

status.editSupported disables the edit option; server rejects edit for primary diagrams, invalid diagram documents, large/long-line Markdown. Browser state does not imply a new public editor permission.

Parent Workspace manageShare/shareAction captures noteId+viewEpoch; note switch closes form and ignores stale response; duplicate mutations are blocked by shareBusy. Shared status updates after successful result.

Busy disables permission/expiry/source controls and action/Done buttons. ShareDialog does not explicitly disable NModal mask/Escape/close-x dismissal while busy; copy-link remains callable. Do not invent a busy dismissal lock.

sourceContracts.title: Owner share create/edit/reset/revoke form
permissionRules: Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.
Full ShareDialog owner form is owned by this workspace inventory. Settings inventory owns ShareManagement listing/entry only; public inventory owns anonymous reader/editor.

status.editSupported disables the edit option; server rejects edit for primary diagrams, invalid diagram documents, large/long-line Markdown. Browser state does not imply a new public editor permission.

Parent Workspace manageShare/shareAction captures noteId+viewEpoch; note switch closes form and ignores stale response; duplicate mutations are blocked by shareBusy. Shared status updates after successful result.

Busy disables permission/expiry/source controls and action/Done buttons. ShareDialog does not explicitly disable NModal mask/Escape/close-x dismissal while busy; copy-link remains callable. Do not invent a busy dismissal lock.

fields.name: 公开链接
fields.constraints: Shown only when status.enabled && resolved URL; generated absolute URL from status.url and current origin; copying conveys access capability.

fields.name: 分享权限
fields.constraints: view | edit. edit option disabled when !status.editSupported; initialized from current status.

fields.name: 链接有效期
fields.constraints: 1h | 1d | 7d | 30d | custom | permanent; private form defaults7d; existing expiring share defaults custom; no expiry defaults permanent.

fields.name: 自定义到期时间
fields.constraints: Required only when custom; valid future local device datetime; converted to ISO. Unchanged original minute display retains original ISO expiry precision. Server requires valid calendar ISO timestamp with Z or offset and expiry>Date.now; null means permanent.

fields.name: 允许下载图形原件
fields.constraints: allowDiagramSource boolean; defaults false for unshared grant; initialized from status; original may include editing content absent from preview.

actions.label: 生成分享链接 / 保存分享设置
actions.effect: Create active grant or update active token options; show returned URL/status
actions.guard: !shareBusy; valid future custom expiry; permission supported; current noteId/epoch

actions.label: 复制链接
actions.effect: Clipboard copy absolute URL; fallback asks manual selection
actions.guard: status.enabled && shareUrl; no busy disable on this copy button

actions.label: 重置链接
actions.effect: Replace active token so old URL stops working; retain submitted form settings
actions.guard: Button only shown when enabled; !busy; same form expiry validation

actions.label: 取消分享
actions.effect: Revoke current share directly; no additional confirmation dialog implemented
actions.guard: Button only shown when enabled; !busy; server revocation works even if source became unreadable

actions.label: 完成 / 模态关闭
actions.guard: Done disabled while busy; NModal close event has no explicit busy guard

importantStates: Saved changes publish; unsaved changes stay private

responsive.behavior: Shared .dialog-card width min(550px,100vw-28px), max90dvh scroll. Share settings two columns desktop, one column<=540px; actions wrap and buttons flex on narrow screens. Actual320/390/1440 layout unverified.

submittedPrompt: 制作中文“分享笔记”手机弹窗设计板，仅A/B两个独立窄列视口，A390/B320比例，正常字号，白底细边线小圆角，中性背景，不画宿主导航/手机壳/系统栏。标题“分享笔记”和可达关闭X。当前已开启仅查看分享、自定义未来时间、非busy，长表单内部竖向滚动，A是上部、B同一表单下部，不能缩字塞一屏。A正文：笔记标题“知识与行动”旁徽标“分享已开启”；label“公开链接”，只读输入“https://example.invalid/s/example”与蓝色“复制链接”按钮，长链接只在框内滚动；说明“持有链接的人无需登录，即可查看这篇笔记。”；label“分享权限”下拉“仅查看”；label“链接有效期”下拉“自定义时间”；label“自定义到期时间”datetime-local输入“2026-12-05 18:00”，小字“按当前设备的本地时间设置。”，后续需滚动。B下半部先露出同一自定义时间字段，再checkbox“允许下载图形原件”（未勾），小字“原件可能包含预览未展示的编辑内容，默认关闭。”；然后浅灰信息块刷新图标、“实时更新”、“展示最新保存内容，未保存的修改不会公开。”；最后真实操作顺序“重置链接”、红色文字“取消分享”、蓝色“保存分享设置”、“完成”，窄屏自然换行全部可达。不得把仅查看解释写成允许编辑，不增加分享密码/确认撤销弹窗，不把真实可用链接或令牌画入图中，不加busy关闭锁或成功提示。
